summary: Traced the completion path for an accepted-but-overwritten proposal: drop notifications are produced only where raft refuses a proposal before appending (transfer in progress, follower without a leader, candidate) and reach the pending entry through the update's dropped-entry list, while an entry superseded after a leadership change produces no notification and is released by the deadline path as RequestTimeout. Recorded one knowledge entry and an explained, refuted account; also confirmed raftio.NodeInfo carries no witness flag, so the earlier defect's counterevidence stands unchanged. No execution requested.
